name: Methocinnamox
summary: Methocinnamox (MCAM) is an opioid receptor antagonist. It is a pseudo-irreversible non-competitive antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor and a competitive antagonist of the κ- and δ-opioid receptors. The drug has a very long duration of action of up to months with a single dose due to its pseudo-irreversibility. It is administered in animals by intravenous or subcutaneous injection.
